Question:
Malaika is skiing on a mountain. The graph below shows her elevation, in meters, above the base of the mountain as she skis along a trail. In total, how many seconds does she spend at an elevation between \(4\) and \(7\) meters?

[Figure 1](figures/2023_AMC_8_Q09_question_fig1.svg)
Solution:
The requested elevations form a horizontal band on the graph, between heights \(4\) and \(7\). Draw the two horizontal boundary lines and find the parts of the curve lying inside that band.

[Figure 1](figures/2023_AMC_8_Q09_official_expansion_solution_fig1.png)

Reading the times from the horizontal axis, these parts run from \(2\) to \(4\) seconds, from \(6\) to \(10\) seconds, and from \(12\) to \(14\) seconds. Their durations are the differences between the end and start times, so the total is

\[
(4-2)+(10-6)+(14-12)=2+4+2=8.
\]

She spends \(\boxed{8}\) seconds in the elevation band, choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\). The vertical axis identifies which parts of the curve count; the horizontal axis measures how long they last.
